info.title: BPMP Platform Public API
info.description: Authoritative public HTTP contract for workflow commands, human work, completed-process queries, audit queries, runtime configuration, Human Runtime assignment policies, and the initial process-model draft lifecycle (when Authoring is configured).

bffSession.name: __Host-bpmp_session
bffSession.description: Opaque Unified Portal BFF session. Unsafe methods also require X-CSRF-Token.

TenantID.name: X-BPMP-Tenant-ID
TenantID.description: Required for Bearer authentication. Optional for BFF sessions and must match the authoritative session tenant when present.

RequestID.name: X-Request-ID
RequestID.description: Caller request identifier. The platform validates and echoes it, or generates a new value.

CSRFToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CSRFToken.description: Required on unsafe methods authenticated by bffSession.

RequestID.description: Identifier for this request across service hops.

CorrelationID.description: Identifier for the end-to-end business operation.

variables.description: Typed initial workflow variables. The workflow configuration may bind one string variable as the process branch ID.

outputs.description: Optional typed workflow variables persisted with the user-task completion event. Values are booleans, signed 64-bit integers, strings, or nested lists (maximum 16 levels and 256 items per list); objects, null, and fractional numbers are rejected. Maximum 128 output variables.

UpsertAssignmentPolicyRequest.description: Exactly one of assignee_id or candidate_group must be populated. expected_version=0 creates; otherwise it must equal current version.

WorkflowVariableOutputValue.description: Boolean, signed 64-bit integer, string, or nested list; maximum nesting depth 16 and 256 items per list.
